CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2765 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 4df5a42f137bbc9392bb41e79f0d9d08ae956a5b. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 4df5a42f137bbc9392bb41e79f0d9d08ae956a5b for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-fly-yield-guard-r2, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-fly-yield-guard-r2 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-fly-yield-guard-r2; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
This is a REPAIR of open pull request #2765 (fix/r10-fly-yield-guard), round 2 of review, which blocked at head 4df5a42f137bbc9392bb41e79f0d9d08ae956a5b. Fetch origin fix/r10-fly-yield-guard, cut your worktree from that head, and read the blocked verdict: git fetch origin refs/heads/review/2765 and git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md (verdict line: Fix review: blocked 4df5a42f137bbc9392bb41e79f0d9d08ae956a5b carry-missing: not carried to R10-ORCH-LEDGER or R10-ORCH-DISPATCH-REG; the three forward-carries name R10-ORCH-MACHINERY, which is absorbe). Follow the fixer contract (dev/governance/roles/fixer.md) from step 2 on. Settle every blocking item in the verdict by code, a roster carry, or a re-taken body as the verdict names it, with a null control for every quantified claim. Push refs only: handoff/r10-fly-yield-guard plus handoff-body/r10-fly-yield-guard (the topic is r10-fly-yield-guard even though this dispatch ref carries a -r2 suffix). Answer `## Red checks` for every red check, with BASH_ENV unset for prepr.

No host or home paths in anything you push (cite repo-relative paths only). Do not end the turn while a background job runs.
